retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic sepia portrait featuring a seated figure in a flowing satin skirt with expressive, organic hand-lettered typography overlaid on the lower third.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body portrait of a woman seated on the floor in a contemplative pose, rendered in a warm, desaturated sepia palette. The composition is anchored by the heavy, lustrous folds of a long satin skirt, with custom, fluid white lettering floating across the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm sepia tone unifies the subject and the background into a single atmospheric space.
The high-sheen satin fabric contrasts with the soft, matte skin and background textures.
The white typography acts as a bright foreground layer against the darker mid-tones of the skirt.
The downward gaze of the subject creates a triangular internal focus leading to the text.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic warm-grey or sepia color grading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally aligned, occupying the vertical center, with the lower half of the frame dominated by the skirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The voluminous folds of the satin skirt serve as the structural base for the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the arms down to the skirt, and rests on the large-scale typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the upper body and head provides a sense of airiness despite the heavy tones.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, avoiding true blacks to maintain a vintage feel.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, gestural strokes with varying line weights
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature exaggerated, sweeping curves
Lowercase letters are compact with long, wispy terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script style used for both primary and secondary information to maintain a cohesive hand-drawn look.
graphicDevices: Horizontal swashes that bleed off the edges

preserve: The gestural, sweeping quality of the 'D' and 'C'

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the unique, fluid motion of the original lettering.
Provides the necessary organic feel and stroke variation.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned photograph of a woman seated on a floor, wearing a white tank top and a long, voluminous satin skirt. Use soft, diffused lighting and a slight film grain. The background should be a simple, textured wall in a matching warm beige tone.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered white script across the lower third of the image. The lettering should be large, fluid, and expressive, with long horizontal flourishes that overlap the folds of the skirt.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Does the skirt have a visible satin sheen?
Is the typography white and hand-drawn in appearance?
Is the subject's pose contemplative and centered?

adjustableVariables: Volume and sheen of the skirt fabric
Scale and flourish length of the typography

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Sepia tone is consistent across the entire frame
The satin fabric looks realistic and lustrous
The composition feels balanced and grounded at the bottom
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in soft-focus sepia + voluminous satin textures + oversized white hand-lettered script overlay.
